targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT ServiceName) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
SELECT sum(Value) as value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.count' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT round(argMax(Value, TimeUnix) * 100, 2) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName = 'spark-master' AND MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.recent_utilization' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT round(sum(Value) / 1048576, 0) as value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'spark-master' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName = 'spark-master' AND MetricName = 'queueSize' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT sum(Value) as value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.thread.count' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master')*100,2) as `spark-master`, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1')*100,2) as `spark-worker-1`, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2')*100,2) as `spark-worker-2`, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-3')*100,2) as `spark-worker-3` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.recent_utilization' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master')/1073741824,3) as `spark-master`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1')/1073741824,3) as `spark-worker-1`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2')/1073741824,3) as `spark-worker-2`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-3')/1073741824,3) as `spark-worker-3` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master') as `spark-master`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') as `spark-worker-1`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') as `spark-worker-2`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-3') as `spark-worker-3` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.thread.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(sumIf(Value, MetricName='jvm.memory.used')/1048576,0) as `heap-used-mb`, round(sumIf(Value, MetricName='jvm.memory.committed')/1048576,0) as `heap-committed-mb` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName IN ('jvm.memory.used','jvm.memory.committed') AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type']='heap' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, Attributes['jvm.memory.pool.name']='G1 Eden Space')/1048576,2) as `G1-Eden`, round(avgIf(Value, Attributes['jvm.memory.pool.name']='G1 Survivor Space')/1048576,2) as `G1-Survivor`, round(avgIf(Value, Attributes['jvm.memory.pool.name']='G1 Old Gen')/1048576,2) as `G1-Old` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type']='heap' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Memory After Last GC — Per Node (MB)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master')/1048576,2) as `spark-master`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1')/1048576,2) as `spark-worker-1`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2')/1048576,2) as `spark-worker-2`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-3')/1048576,2) as `spark-worker-3` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used_after_last_gc' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type']='heap' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, Attributes['jvm.memory.pool.name']='Metaspace')/1048576,2) as `Metaspace`, round(avgIf(Value, Attributes['jvm.memory.pool.name']='Compressed Class Space')/1048576,2) as `Compressed-Class`, round(avgIf(Value, Attributes['jvm.memory.pool.name'] LIKE '%non-profiled%')/1048576,2) as `CodeHeap-non-profiled` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type']='non_heap' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master') as `master-classes`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') as `worker-1-classes`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') as `worker-2-classes` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.class.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT round(max(Value),0) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.consumer.records_lag_max' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(sum(Value),2) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.consumer.records_consumed_rate' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT sum(Value) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.consumer.assigned_partitions' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(min(Value),0) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.consumer.records_lead_min' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') as `worker-1-lag`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') as `worker-2-lag`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-3') as `worker-3-lag` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.consumer.records_lag_max' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.consumer.records_consumed_rate'),2) as `records-consumed/s`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.consumer.fetch_rate'),4) as `fetch-rate` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName IN ('kafka.consumer.records_consumed_rate','kafka.consumer.fetch_rate') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.consumer.fetch_latency_avg'),2) as `fetch-latency-avg`, round(maxIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.consumer.fetch_latency_max'),2) as `fetch-latency-max` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName IN ('kafka.consumer.fetch_latency_avg','kafka.consumer.fetch_latency_max') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.consumer.bytes_consumed_rate'),2) as `bytes-consumed/s`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.consumer.incoming_byte_rate'),2) as `incoming-bytes/s` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName IN ('kafka.consumer.bytes_consumed_rate','kafka.consumer.incoming_byte_rate') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT round(sum(Value),2) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.producer.record_send_rate' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(avg(Value),2) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.producer.request_latency_avg' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(avg(Value),0) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.producer.batch_size_avg' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(sum(Value),4) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'kafka.producer.record_error_rate' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

panels.title: Producer Send Rate & Byte Rate Over Time

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.record_send_rate'),2) as `send-rate-rec/s`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.outgoing_byte_rate')/1024,2) as `outgoing-KB/s` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName IN ('kafka.producer.record_send_rate','kafka.producer.outgoing_byte_rate') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.request_latency_avg'),2) as `latency-avg`, round(maxIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.request_latency_max'),2) as `latency-max`, round(avgIf(Value, MetricName='kafka.producer.record_queue_time_avg'),2) as `queue-time-avg` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName IN ('kafka.producer.request_latency_avg','kafka.producer.request_latency_max','kafka.producer.record_queue_time_avg') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT Timestamp as timestamp, Body as body, SeverityText as level, ServiceName FROM otel_logs WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
